descriptionHtml:
ASUS Prime B760M-R D4 Intel B760 LGA 1700 Micro-ATX Motherboard


Maximize your desktop performance with the cost-effective and highly reliable ASUS Prime B760M-R D4 micro-ATX motherboard. Expertly engineered to support 14th, 13th, and 12th Generation Intel Core processors, this Intel B760 chipset-based motherboard offers a solid foundation for building budget-friendly gaming rigs and efficient home office setups. With its robust power design, comprehensive cooling features, and intelligent tuning options, it ensures your system remains perfectly stable under daily computing workloads.


The ASUS Prime B760M-R D4 delivers next-gen data speeds with a PCIe 4.0 x16 slot for modern graphics cards and dual onboard M.2 slots (PCIe 4.0) for fast NVMe SSD storage. It fully embraces cost-efficient high-speed dual-channel DDR4 memory configurations, making it a great choice for system upgrades. Complete with Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet for smooth networking, USB 3.2 Gen 1 ports, and premium ASUS 5X Protection III hardware safeguards, this motherboard offers essential future-proof connectivity and durable, long-term reliability.
